synchronization: One audio clip per guide card, with 0.25 seconds of padding

records.title: Start a record
records.transcript: Welcome to FarmVoice Records. Let’s make a farm record together.

records.title: Choose your field
records.transcript: Choose your field, then tap the microphone and describe the work you did.

records.title: Review suggestions
records.transcript: FarmVoice can suggest details from your note, including the product, amount, location, and date.

records.title: Check and save
records.transcript: Check those suggestions, fill in anything missing, and save when you’re ready.

records.title: Finish later
records.transcript: You can also save a draft and finish it later.

fields.title: Set up fields
fields.transcript: Let’s set up your fields. Open Fields and add a production area with a name your crew will recognize.

fields.title: Add identifiers
fields.transcript: Include any farm, tract, or field identifiers you have.

fields.title: Import boundaries
fields.transcript: If you have boundary files, open Import USDA Fields and upload a supported ZIP or GeoJSON file.

fields.title: Check the map
fields.transcript: Check the names and boundaries before saving.

fields.title: Keep field history
fields.transcript: Keeping work linked to the right field makes its history easier to review.

team.title: Plan work
team.transcript: Let’s get your crew organized. Open Team to invite workers and plan the week’s work.

team.title: Invite workers
team.transcript: Share the complete join code so each worker can join with their own account.

team.title: Record time
team.transcript: Workers can clock in and out, with location captured at supported events.

team.title: Crew leader help
team.transcript: A crew leader can help keep records when workers don’t have phones.

team.title: Approve and export
team.transcript: Review completed time before approving it, then export the hours for payroll preparation.

h2a.title: Start with the roster
h2a.transcript: Let’s organize your H-2A records. Start with the contract and worker roster, then give each person the appropriate role.

h2a.title: Record the day
h2a.transcript: A crew leader can record the worksite, hours offered, hours worked, and piece counts for the day.

h2a.title: Review entries
h2a.transcript: Review the entries before approval, and explain any later corrections.

h2a.title: Keep documents
h2a.transcript: Keep supporting documents together so you can check the records against the actual work and your applicable requirements.

housing.title: Add the property
housing.transcript: Let’s keep your housing records organized. Add the property, its address, occupancy details, and inspection dates.

housing.title: Confirm free housing
housing.transcript: When assigning housing, confirm that it is provided without rent only after you have checked that fact.

housing.title: Inspect and document
housing.transcript: Complete the inspection checklist and add dated photos.

housing.title: Complete repairs
housing.transcript: If something needs repair, assign the work and record its completion.

housing.title: Review the packet
housing.transcript: Review the housing packet against your source documents and applicable requirements.

quickbooks.title: Select the farm
quickbooks.transcript: Let’s connect QuickBooks. First, select the correct farm.

quickbooks.title: Connect securely
quickbooks.transcript: Choose Connect QuickBooks and complete the Intuit sign-in.

quickbooks.title: Check the company
quickbooks.transcript: When you return, check that the company name is right.

quickbooks.title: Match workers
quickbooks.transcript: Match each FarmVoice worker to the correct QuickBooks employee, and set the payroll time zone.

quickbooks.title: Send approved time
quickbooks.transcript: Send completed, manager-approved time, then review the results.

quickbooks.title: Reconnect if needed
quickbooks.transcript: If the connection expires, reconnect before trying again.
